title: Save, load, and classify with a versioned ClassifierBundle
description:
## Purpose

Freeze each flywheel version as a versioned, verifiable `ClassifierBundle` that can be reloaded to classify new items.

## Scope (design §1.2)

- A directory with `bundle.json` (canonical text-free JSON, SHA-256 integrity hash, strict keys, in the `artifacts.py` style), `examples.jsonl` (private example texts, never committed, each row verified against manifest hashes on load), and `scorecard.yaml` (rubric and head in Jev-Flywheel `Score` format, hashed).
- `bundle.json` blocks: `task`, `engine` (adapter, configured and reported model, `model_identity`), `rubric`, `fewshot` (FixedExampleList + optimizer audit), `head`, `retrieval` (`null` by default), `lineage`.
- `load_bundle(dir)` verifies every hash and the task fingerprint, compares configured vs stored engine model, and warns if the reported model differs.
- `classify`: **one** request with the fixed list in the state and the holistic question plus every rubric element; a second request only when retrieval is enabled. Returns label, calibrated probability, top contributions.
- Core wraps the Jev-Flywheel YAML; it does not copy `Score`/`fit_head` (Q4 open). Keep the core interface provider-neutral.
- **Request shape decided (owner, Q2, 2026-10-01): one request per item** with the examples in the state; the answer cache key includes the list fingerprint. Phase 2, design build step 9.

## Definition of done

Specs first: a reloaded bundle gives identical predictions to the in-memory one on a fake engine; a tampered file or mismatched example text is rejected; a reported-model mismatch produces an observable warning; no credentials or texts in `bundle.json`. `make test` green. Cost: $0.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Save, load, and classify with a versioned ClassifierBundle
  Scenario: A reloaded bundle predicts exactly like the original
    Given a classifier bundle built in memory with a fake engine
    When it is saved, reloaded, and asked to classify the same items
    Then the labels, probabilities, and contributions are identical
  Scenario: Tampering is detected
    Given a saved bundle whose examples file was edited
    When it is loaded
    Then loading fails with an integrity error before any model call
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2, §1.3, §6 step 9, §7 Q2/Q4/Q6.

- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-5e067f89-04ba-4b0e-84b3-09ae93c8127b`.
- [Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-evaluations-128450f9-bdfb-47e0-9c69-7203be6598d3`.

comments.text: Done in f2efcfc. src/decision_flywheel/bundle.py: ClassifierBundle (task, opaque scorecard payload + caller-parsed Rubric with questions()/predict(), optional FixedExampleList with its example rows, engine, text-free head/provenance/fewshot-audit/lineage) with save() -> bundle.json (canonical, SHA-256 hash, strict blocks task/engine/rubric/fewshot/head/retrieval=null/lineage), examples.jsonl (private), scorecard.yaml (hashed); load_bundle(dir, task, parse_rubric, configured_model=...) verifies every hash, the task fingerprint, each example row against the list's input hashes and the configured model; classify() sends ONE system_one request with every rubric question and state {labeled_examples, target} (or {text} zero-shot), reserve rule included, and warns (BundleModelWarning) if the engine reports another model. Core wraps the Jev-Flywheel YAML; it does not copy Score/fit_head (Q4 still open), and core's LearnedHead is not used. Specs (12): reload gives identical predictions and identical requests on a fake engine, tampering of any file rejected before a model call, task/model mismatch refused, text-free manifest, no overwrite of a different bundle. make test: 238 passed. Used by the Evaluations harness (48d40de): reloaded bundles match the in-memory classifier for all six bundle arms offline.
